workflow_flownode.sql: SELECT f.[workflowid] AS [workflowid],f.[nodeid] AS [nodeid],f.[nodetype] AS [nodetype],f.[IsFreeWorkflow] AS [IsFreeWorkflow],f.[drawbackflag] AS [drawbackflag],f.[rejectbackflag] AS [rejectbackflag],f.[ruleRelationship] AS [ruleRelationship],f.[UseExceptionHandle] AS [UseExceptionHandle],f.[ExceptionHandleWay] AS [ExceptionHandleWay],f.[FlowToAssignNode] AS [FlowToAssignNode],f.[isRejectRemind] AS [isRejectRemind],f.[isChangRejectNode] AS [isChangRejectNode],f.[isSelectRejectNode] AS [isSelectRejectNode],f.[rejectableNodes] AS [rejectableNodes],f.[rejecttocreater] AS [rejecttocreater],f.[rejectToCreateNode] AS [rejectToCreateNode],f.[isSubmitDirectNode] AS [isSubmitDirectNode],f.[selectNextFlow] AS [selectNextFlow],f.[selectNextFlowType] AS [selectNextFlowType],f.[selectNextFlowNode] AS [selectNextFlowNode],f.[selectLinkNodeType] AS [selectLinkNodeType],f.[branchstartnodeuuid] AS [branchstartnodeuuid],f.[branchendnodeuuid] AS [branchendnodeuuid],f.[branchnodeuuid] AS [branchnodeuuid] FROM dbo.[workflow_flownode] f WHERE f.workflowid IN (SELECT id FROM dbo.workflow_base) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.workflow_nodebase n WHERE n.id=f.nodeid AND n.requestid IS NOT NULL AND n.requestid<>0)

workflow_nodebase.sql: SELECT n.[id] AS [id],n.[nodename] AS [nodename],n.[isstart] AS [isstart],n.[isreject] AS [isreject],n.[isreopen] AS [isreopen],n.[isend] AS [isend],n.[nodeattribute] AS [nodeattribute],n.[passnum] AS [passnum],n.[IsFreeNode] AS [IsFreeNode],n.[floworder] AS [floworder],n.[Signtype] AS [Signtype],n.[startnodeid] AS [startnodeid] FROM dbo.[workflow_nodebase] n WHERE (n.requestid IS NULL OR n.requestid=0) AND n.id IN (SELECT f.nodeid FROM dbo.workflow_flownode f WHERE f.workflowid IN (SELECT id FROM dbo.workflow_base) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.workflow_nodebase n WHERE n.id=f.nodeid AND n.requestid IS NOT NULL AND n.requestid<>0))

workflow_nodelink.sql: SELECT l.[id] AS [id],l.[workflowid] AS [workflowid],l.[nodeid] AS [nodeid],l.[destnodeid] AS [destnodeid],l.[linkname] AS [linkname],l.[isreject] AS [isreject],l.[isautoflow] AS [isautoflow],l.[ismustpass] AS [ismustpass],l.[condition] AS [condition],l.[conditioncn] AS [conditioncn],l.[newconditioncn] AS [newconditioncn],l.[newrule] AS [newrule],l.[ruleRelationship] AS [ruleRelationship],l.[linkorder] AS [linkorder] FROM dbo.[workflow_nodelink] l WHERE l.workflowid IN (SELECT id FROM dbo.workflow_base) AND l.wfrequestid IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.workflow_nodebase n WHERE n.id IN (l.nodeid,l.destnodeid) AND n.requestid IS NOT NULL AND n.requestid<>0)
